name: Yowler's Paw
summary: In Lakeshire, Yowler's Paw is brought to Verner Osgood as proof the feared gnoll leader is dead. Yowler leads the packs menacing the hills above Lakeshire.

sections.title: Trophy of the Pack Leader
sections.body: Yowler leads the Redridge gnolls that terrorize the heights around Lake Everstill, their howls reaching Lakeshire. He is feared above all, a ruthless alpha driving the packs' expansion. Verner Osgood asks brave adventurers to bring him Yowler's paw, the customary proof of a bounty across human territories. Taking the paw marks the death of an unusually cunning predator and a blow against the chain of command among his disorganized followers.

sections.title: A Town Left on Its Own
sections.body: Yowler's Paw points to the danger facing Lakeshire. The Stormwind Army is consumed by the Blackrock orc threat entrenched around Stonewatch Keep, leaving civil authorities and townspeople to hire passing mercenaries for defense. Without regular royal garrisons, settlers such as Verner Osgood rely on proof that threats have been dealt with to keep local roads marginally safe for trade and travel.

faq.answer: Verner Osgood, a prominent tradesman and Lakeshire resident, asks for Yowler's Paw. He wants proof that the dangerous alpha gnoll terrorizing the hills has been dealt with for good.
Yowler leads the Redridge gnoll packs. His brute strength and cunning let him rally multiple packs, making him an urgent danger to nearby townsfolk.

faq.q: Why does Lakeshire rely on bounties instead of Stormwind soldiers?
faq.answer: The Stormwind Army is overwhelmed by Blackrock orcs fortified at Stonewatch Keep in eastern Redridge. With no reinforcements to spare, townsfolk such as Verner Osgood rely on freelance adventurers to hunt threats like Yowler.

faq.q: What happens once Yowler is killed?
faq.answer: Killing Yowler breaks the leadership holding the aggressive gnolls together. His pack scatters into the wilderness, giving Lakeshire's residents temporary breathing room.

angles.text: Defeating Yowler and recovering his paw helps steady Redridge Mountains while Stormwind's military is stretched too thin to protect its own eastern frontier.
As a hunter, tracking the Redridge gnolls' alpha and claiming his paw tests your skills at tracking and handling beasts against a dangerous predator.
